title: torch stable ABI amax first argument ought to have type const Tensor&
bug_description:
While porting torchaudio to use torch stable ABI I noticed that in
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/05eeb29976fffd8331ea6c7d30960fdf48626294/torch/csrc/stable/ops.h#L157
the first argument type ought to be `const Tensor&` because `amax` is not an in-place operation.

Same comment applies to
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/6e548c1a87906de3ac30f02dd2ea647f83eae87c/torch/csrc/stable/ops.h#L169

@janeyx99 do you agree and accept a PR fixing it?


cc @ezyang @bhosmer @smessmer @ljk53 @bdhirsh
